HOW TO PLAY

1

Clone / Duplicate (Distance 1)Green Ring

Click one of your pieces and select an adjacent hex (1 step). A brand new piece is spawned on the target cell while keeping your original piece intact.

2

Jump / Leap (Distance 2)Amber Ring

Leap across two spaces to reach tactical positions. Jumping moves the original piece to the destination without duplicating.

3

Infection / ConversionCascade Attack

Whenever your piece lands, all neighboring opponent pieces immediately convert to your color! Strategic moves can turn multiple enemy gems at once.

4

Victory Condition

The game ends when all board spaces are occupied or an opponent is wiped out. The player with the highest territory count claims victory!

⚡
TACTICAL PLAYBOOK

Grandmaster Strategies & Pro Tips

Mastering hexagonal geometry requires spatial awareness and understanding the critical trade-off between territory growth (cloning) and aggressive leaps (jumping).

DEFENSE

Edge & Corner Anchoring

Hexes on outer perimeters have only 3 to 4 neighbors compared to 6 in the interior. Anchoring along edges prevents opponents from surrounding and converting your clusters.

CAUTION

Beware the Reckless Jump

Leaping into open territory leaves an isolated token exposed to counter-infections. Prefer cloning over jumping unless the capture yields a 3+ piece swing or seals an endgame cluster.

CONTROL

Choke Points & Bridges

In maps like Donut Void or Hourglass, controlling narrow bridges cuts off the opponent's expansion, forcing them to jump blindly into your traps.

ENDGAME

Chain Conversions

When the board is over 80% full, single moves can convert up to 6 adjacent hexes at once. Calculate multiple moves ahead to ensure your conversion cannot be immediately recaptured.

About Hexxagon Online

Online Hex Board Game is a modern recreation of the legendary 1993 board game Hexxagon, originally created by Software Creations.

Engineering Highlights:
  • Pure SVG Axial Vector Geometry & O(1) Lookups
  • Hardware-Accelerated Web Audio Synthesizer
  • Minimax AI with Alpha-Beta Pruning
  • Zero-Scroll Adaptive Resolution Architecture
